notes: Summary: Stalled / closed-lost due to regulatory compliance — FINRA paperwork and pre-approval required by their compliance office; Redwood private offering didn’t meet required vendor control checklist.
Initial interest: Oct 2024 — looking for low-latency LLM to assist traders: market signals summarization + reranking of news + short-form decision support.
POC: Nov-Dec 2024 — 2-week POC against anonymized tick-level dataset; model: open-llama-70b quantized; achieved functional accuracy, median latency 120ms (token), peaks 300ms under load.

Security review: Dec 2024 — compliance returned vendor audit with three red-lines: vendor-controlled key management (KMS), lack of FINRA-specific attestations, and no ability to operate in their air-gapped environment.
Quote from Compliance call 2025-01-08: "We need a FINRA-approved vendor or on-prem package with documented audit trails; until then we can't proceed."
Sales timeline: outreach -> discovery -> demo -> POC -> security review -> procurement. Procurement paused on 2025-01-10 after legal denial.

Internal notes: AE Maya Chen spent extra effort to map controls (SOC2/ISO artifacts provided), SE Ravi ran a lightweight latency/throughput tuning run. Offered Dedicated with strict VPC + customer-managed KMS but compliance still required vendor pre-approval for trading-related ML.
Why lost: primary blocker was regulatory vendor pre-approval (FINRA) and lack of a champion after Head of Quant left. Secondary: budget hold for new vendor integrations.

Potential re-engage triggers: Redwood publishes FINRA compliance pack / third-party attestation or provides a validated air-gapped on-prem installer; internal champion hired back or procurement re-opens in FY25.
Action items left: file closed-lost, upload all notes to deal folder, mark competitor win (BigCloudAI) in CRM, set reminder for 2025-07 to reassess compliance posture and re-open if controls change.
